QuestInfo.name: [My Kidult Day] Guide
QuestInfo.0:
#e#b<My Kidult Day>#k#n

#e[Event Period]#n
05/17/2021 12:00 AM - 05/19/2021 11:59 PM UTC

#e[Event Details]#n
Maple World's eternal junior, Little Richie, has something to say!
"I used to have to wait for Father to buy me presents. Now I'm a grownup, and I can buy myself whatever I want!"

Since you're an adult too, after adventuring in Maple World for the past 16 years, Little Richie tells you to buy whatever you wished your parents would get you!
But you've learned since childhood -- nothing is free!
